query:
SELECT a.id, 
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.l1SubmittedCostUsd') as l1,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.l2CompositeOptimisedCostUsd') as l2,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.l3BenchmarkReferenceCostUsd') as l3,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.negotiationFeasibilityScore') as nfs,
  JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.compositeLineItems')) as line_item_count,
  JSON_EXTRACT(a.cost_intelligence_json, '$.compositeOptimisation.compositeLineItems[0]') as first_line_item
FROM ai_assessments a WHERE id IN (6390001, 6360001);
